corrections: Law current: Law 'On Non-Commercial Organizations' No. 111 of 15.10.1999, in force, last amended by Law No. 72 of 02.04.2024 (foreign-representative law) — already reflected in the row. Fee is wrong/outdated: official schedule (CM Resolution No. 470 of 23.08.2022, as amended by No. 727 of 29.12.2023) sets NPO state fee at 100 KGS in the standard statutory period, 4,281 KGS within 3 working days (the row's 2,000 KGS/US$22 matches no current tier; at ~87 KGS/USD the true figures are ~US$1.15 standard or ~US$49 expedited). '3 working days' time matches the statutory registration period. No-local-presence verdict is supported: a fund may be founded by a single foreign natural person (law allows founders 'regardless of place of registration and residence'), only a local registered address is required, and digital e-filing is confirmed by the registration regulation under CM Resolution No. 257 of 17.04.2026.
